hops.name: Saaz
hops.notes: Saaz hops are the famous landrace variety from the Czechia region, but this is specifically US Saaz, grown by our friends at Virgil Gamache Farms in Toppenish, WA. US Saaz caries some of the same floral and spicy elements as Czech Saaz, but this American-grown lot presents with brighter citrus and a hint of cherry. US Saaz hops work well in classic European styles and lagers, but also fits perfectly in new twists on those styles. Aroma: Classic noble aromas. Floral, citrus, and spice. Typical Analytical Range Alpha: 3.0-5.0% Beta: 4.0-6.0% Total Oil: 0.3-1.0 ml/100g US SAAZ HOP SUBSTITUTIONS US Saaz is the obvious choice to replace the scarce Czech grown Saaz. US Saaz hops carry similar characteristics and flavor profiles as East Kent Golding, US Golding, and Hallertau Mittlefrüh making these hops an excellent substitution in your next light lager.

hops.name: African Queen

yeasts.description:
This innovative yeast doesn’t just make great beer for almost any style (including lager), it’s also a sustainable choice that’s ahead of the curve. High Voltage thrives at much warmer temperatures than traditional brewing strains, and this has game-changing implications for your brewery’s efficiency and environmental impact.

By operating at these elevated temperatures you can drastically improve your tank turnaround time due to increased fermentation kinetics, significantly reduce your energy consumption and get your creations to market faster, meeting the ever-increasing demand for your brews.

High Voltage is remarkably clean, with little ester production. It allows the hops and malt in your beer to shine through without any unwanted interference. Whether you’re crafting a refreshing pseudo-lager, stout or IPA this is the perfect single strain solution for your brewery.
yeasts.name: Electrifyingly Clean Thermotolerant

miscs.name: Yeast Nutrient (WLN1000)
miscs.notes:
White Labs Yeast Nutrient is used to increase the health of yeast, this improves fermentation and re-pitching performance. It contains diammonium phosphate (DAP), essential vitamins and co-factors, nitrogen, amino acids, proteins, peptides, and minerals. An effective boost for first and/or late-generation yeast slurry. If the grist is not 100% malt, then White Labs Yeast Nutrient can help make up for the lack of nutrients.

We recommend using traditional finings agents for most fermentations. If you are still struggling with unwanted haze, filtration may be necessary.

hops.notes: A dual-purpose hop that offers great bittering properties as well as a well-rounded aroma profile. Aroma: Herbal - tea, pepper, floral, citrus, earthy, woody, grassy, caramel Alpha Acid: 4.0 - 9.0% Beta Acid: 2.5 - 4.5% Total Oil: 0.5 - 1.3 ml/100g

miscs.name: Yeast Nutrient (WLN1000)
miscs.notes:
White Labs Yeast Nutrient is used to increase the health of yeast, this improves fermentation and re-pitching performance. It contains diammonium phosphate (DAP), essential vitamins and co-factors, nitrogen, amino acids, proteins, peptides, and minerals. An effective boost for first and/or late-generation yeast slurry. If the grist is not 100% malt, then White Labs Yeast Nutrient can help make up for the lack of nutrients.

We recommend using traditional finings agents for most fermentations. If you are still struggling with unwanted haze, filtration may be necessary.
